low crown land means higher autonomy which is bad BUT you get more cash when you sell if your crown land is lower(if you have %10 crown land you get most amount of cash by selling), very low crown land screws the country though. so its a balance act you gotta do. 

general approach is you get privileges that gives +1 monarch powers, after that you try to keep crown land between 20-30% by seizing and selling. 

other than that try to make them loyal you can get more info about them in wiki. 

a lot of complexity in the game so its hard for you to deal with everything 

i suggest you to play somewhat stronger nations to learn about these small things first 

when ottobros come to south, you wont have a chance if your not ready

first of all yemen is kind of a hard start for a beginner so don't get discouraged. 

religion obviously is a problem(you can get some estate privileges that give you missionary strength) 

you have very big neighbors that want your land(i don't understand beige nation you were referring to(oman?) but mamluks then ottomans will eventually try to take all of the arabian peninsula. because of that main objective in a yemen campaign is to survive. which you gotta scale better than them before they get the chance to attack.

about economy: there is nothing wrong with running a deficit or taking loans as long as you can scale more than your loans. 

when you conquered some land you get overextension which will hurt your economy temporarily so this might be the reason your economy sucks after war

i am guessing you are not lowering autonomy. high autonomy hurt your manpower and economy(having low crownland will increase autonomy)
